custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations, the test location and location B, so a part can be stocked at location B only.
  • Create a part for this test at location B only, part A, whose part number is in capital letters, with a description, description 1, so part A is not stocked at the test location.
  • Use a description for the new part, description 2, that differs from description 1.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425676-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425676-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description reads description 2.

Step 3:

  • Part Number holds the lower-case number.

Step 4:

  • The category shows in the Category field.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.
  • No "Linked to" message appears.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • Two separate entries are listed: part A's number in capitals with description 1, and the lower-case number, saved exactly as typed, with description 2 (1 + 1 = 2).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-R4: “On save, the system looks for a Part Library entry whose number is exactly the number typed, including upper and lower case.”
  • S7-R7: “If no entry matches, the system creates a Part Library entry with the typed number and description, and links the part to it.”
  • Key Decisions: “In the New Inventory Part dialog, a new part links to an existing Part Library entry only on an exact match. Exact means the same characters, including upper and lower case. Any other number gets an entry of its own. A near match is never linked, because two different products can share a number that differs only in punctuation, and linking them would merge them.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
